description: This file defines internal structures, function prototypes, and inline functions for thread-specific data (TSD) management in jemalloc, including initialization, cleanup, and access functions.

methods.name: tsd_cleanup_wrapper
methods.description: Performs cleanup of thread-specific data, resets initialization state, and handles errors.

methods.name: tsd_wrapper_get
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the thread-specific data wrapper.

methods.name: tsd_boot0
methods.description: Initializes thread-specific data key and sets boot wrapper.

methods.name: tsd_boot1
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the boot wrapper for TSD.

methods.name: tsd_booted_get
methods.description: Returns whether TSD has been booted.

methods.name: tsd_get_allocates
methods.description: Indicates if TSD allocation is enabled.

methods.name: tsd_get
methods.description: Retrieves the thread-specific data value, initializing if necessary.
